newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 26-wk T-bill yield dips to 11.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech 26-wk T-bill yield dips to 11.90 pct.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank Dutch auction offering 5.0 billion crowns ($175.6 million) in 26-week finance ministry treasury bills was the maximum allowed 11.90 percent, the CNB said on Wednesday.
In its last auction of similar bills on January 8, yield was 12.23 percent.
The CNB added that Wednesday's auction was oversubscried with bids totalling 6.61 billion crowns. A total of 4.995 billion crowns in bids were accepted, the CNB said.
In auction on January 8, the CNB set maximum gross yield at 12.75 percent, and the offer of five billion crowns was heavily oversubscribed with yield striking 12.23 percent.
